explanation: At D2 it is always near maximum (9-10), and at GO it mostly tracks the choice and the last reward: choosing a2 gives 5-6 after a rewarded trial and 7-9 after an unrewarded one, while choosing a1 gives 1-2 after a reward and 3-4 after no reward. At D1 it is usually low (0-2), but it rises to 4-6 right after a trial with a rare transition, and it sits at 3-6 during runs of rewarded a1 choices.
